test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following options represents the best choice for the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nutrition support **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nutrition support is the best choice for the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Scheme** because it provides food to children and pregnant and lactating women. 
 
• Children in the age group 0-6 years constitute around 158 million of the population of India (2011 census).
 
• These Children are the future human resource of the country.
 
• **Ministry of Women and Child Development** is implementing various schemes for the welfare, development, and protection of children.
 
• Launched on **2nd October 1975**, the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Scheme is one of the flagship programs of the Government of India and represents one of the **world’s largest and unique programs for early childhood care and development.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is the foremost symbol of the country’s commitment to its children and nursing mothers, as a response to the challenge of providing pre-school non-formal education on one hand and breaking the vicious cycle of malnutrition, morbidity, reduced learning capacity, and mortality on the other.
 
• The beneficiaries under the Scheme are children in the **age group of 0-6 years,** **pregnant women, and lactating mothers.**
 
• **ICDS services**
 
 
• Supplementary Nutrition
 
• Pre-school non-formal education
 
• Nutrition & health education
 
• Immunization
 
• Health check-up
 
• Referral services
